title: Irretrievable
summary: IRRETRIE'VABLE, adjective [in and retrievable, from retrieve.] Not to be recovered or repaired; irrecoverable; irreparable; as an irretrievable loss.

inlines.v: IRRETRIE'VABLE, adjective [in and retrievable, from retrieve.] Not to be recovered or repaired; irrecoverable; irreparable; as an irretrievable loss.
